Beyond 'Thank You': The Science of True Gratitude in Leadership

(un)conversations: Leadership lessons from the pivotal moments of global CEOs, founders and execs
Jul 9 2026 • 1 hr 17 mins
What if gratitude is more than just saying "thank you"? In this episode of (un)conversations®, Dr. Alison Schmidt sits down with Linda Roszak Burton, President of DRW Coaching and author of Gratitude Heals , to explore the transformational power of gratitude in leadership, grief, and organizational culture.
Linda shares her deeply personal journey through losing her sister to breast cancer, and how that profound loss led her to discover the science behind gratitude as "the deepest touch point of human existence." Through her three (UN)words — Unaware, Unspoken, and Underutilized — Linda reveals how leaders can move beyond surface-level appreciation to build psychological safety, strengthen retention, and create genuine human connection in the workplace.
